source: Released 1378 by 7 document role-weight matrix, with fixed original basis and confidence anchor
fit: 512 additional official train judgments with the exact old model reevaluated on the T4, aligned to both contextual encoder streams
edits: Direct closed-form residual solve against seven human score targets, or a bounded pairwise score-margin correction on mistakes. Test both full seven-column and None/Reasoning-column support. Matched-norm permuted residual control.
selection: 48 selector judgments, equally weighted full and lexical-unmatched macro-F1. Do not increase swaps on either selector slice. Identity eligible.
promotion: After the weight lock, require improved macro-F1 and fewer None/Reasoning swaps versus doc-semantic in both independent 72- and 96-case validation panels before exposing this family's official score.
